## Incident Overview

### Source
PR #72 llm-review run 25537710859, finding F2 (severity claimed: important; assessed: minor — see ticket 3365-75c4 for review-calibration context).

### Expected Behavior
`test_phase_resolve_threads_fails_loud_when_llm_dispatch_unset` (in tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh) should assert not only that stderr contains the `ESCALATE:` prefix but also that the error envelope contains the contextual fields the contract documents: `UNRESOLVED:<thread-ids>` and `PR:<pr-url>` — both produced by the deferred guard in merge-to-main-pr.sh after the 1a83-46c5 fix.

### Actual Behavior
The test asserts only on the `ESCALATE:` prefix substring. A regression that drops the UNRESOLVED/PR fields from the error envelope would still pass this test.

### Suggested Fix
Add two assertions in the test:
```
assert_contains "...: stderr must contain UNRESOLVED: pattern" "UNRESOLVED:" "$stderr_out"
assert_contains "...: stderr must contain PR: pattern" "PR:" "$stderr_out"
```

### Severity
P3: test-quality refinement; existing test catches the critical contract (non-zero exit + ESCALATE prefix). Adding these assertions is defensive against future error-format drift, not a current functional gap.

### File / Line References
- tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh — `test_phase_resolve_threads_fails_loud_when_llm_dispatch_unset`
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh — error envelope construction at the deferred-guard site

### Origin
Follow-up from PR #72.
